task.title: Define RED v2 publish to mailbox authorization integration test
task.description: Add focused Go integration tests proving that a successful v2 bundle publish atomically registers its validated DeviceRecord for signed mailbox challenge authorization, including restart persistence.
task.scope: apps/relay v2 publish and mailbox handler/router tests only

acceptance_criteria: After only POST /v2/prekeys/publish, the embedded device can create a correctly signed mailbox challenge without a separate v1 device-record publish.
Authorization survives Badger close/reopen and invalid device signatures remain rejected.
A failed/conflicting v2 publish cannot create or replace an authorized DeviceRecord.
The focused integration is RED only because v2 storage currently omits the DeviceRecord index.
constraints: Read /Users/Goodea/goodea/projects/echolet/.metaproject/index.md before any repository action; load tests-creator/testing.
Tests only; do not edit production code, flow.json, or acceptance-criteria.md.
Use the real router/handlers/Badger and shared signed fixture; use apply_patch and keryx ctx rg; do not commit.
Do not require the CLI to call the legacy v1 device-record endpoint.
Write and validate .metaproject/flows/001-2026-09-05-echolet-assessment-fixes/dispatches/001-T32-tests-result.json; final starts STATUS:.

provenance.source_request: Close v2 publish to mailbox authorization integration gap before CLI E2E.
